channel.title: Carat Capital — The Trade Paper of the Jewelry World
channel.description: Prices, intelligence and analysis from every desk of the stone trade: diamonds, gold and metals, gemstones, watches, auctions, retail and technology.

item.title: Phillips Geneva sells a Journe at CHF 8.68m and a Patek at CHF 6.27m
item.description: Lot 7, a 2002 F.P. Journe Résonance, hammered at CHF 7.1 million against an estimate of more than CHF 1 million, before buyer's premium. The 1945 Patek hammered at CHF 5.1 million against a CHF 4 million high estimate.

item.title: Chow Tai Seng's nine-month franchise income falls 67.84% on the year
item.description: Franchise income was RMB 1.076bn, 19.27% of revenue against 49.39% a year earlier. Own stores and e-commerce made 78% of revenue in the first nine months, Huaxia Times reports from the filing.

item.title: Rexhep Rexhepi's Chronograph Flyback wins the 2026 Aiguille d'Or
item.description: The GPHG gave twenty prizes in Geneva on 7 November. Audemars Piguet, Chopard and Ferdinand Berthoud each won two, and Patek Philippe took the Special Jury Prize for its Watch Art Grand Exhibition.

item.title: China's gold reserves rise 830,000 oz in October, a 24th month
item.description: SAFE data put reserves at 78.30 million ounces, about 2,435.4 tonnes, at the end of October. Eastmoney calls it the largest monthly addition since buying restarted in November 2024.

item.title: Burgundy Diamond Mines ends September with A$596,000 in cash
item.description: Its quarterly cash-flow report shows A$11.67 million at the start of the quarter and, asked to estimate its funding, says none is available. Burgundy says the Ekati receiver reports that mining has ceased.

item.title: 197.80-carat Romanov sapphire leads Sotheby's Geneva royal sale
item.description: Sotheby's Royal and Noble Jewels sale closes on 11 November, led by the sapphire mounted by Cartier. JCK and National Jeweler report a Sotheby's estimate of CHF 850,000 to 1.7 million.

item.title: Titan's Q2 pre-tax profit rises 53%, 18% excluding customs gains
item.description: Profit before tax was about ₹2,329 crore in the quarter to 30 September, on total income of about ₹20,533 crore, up 25%. Excluding ₹536 crore of customs-duty gains, it was about ₹1,793 crore.

item.title: Fancy Color Diamond Index eases 0.1% in Q3, 0.5% below a year ago
item.description: Pink diamonds edged up in the third quarter while blue eased 0.2% and yellow 0.4%, the Fancy Color Research Foundation says. Fancy Vivid Pink, the grade that led, rose 1.0%.

item.title: Bonhams estimates an F.P. Journe Souscription at €700,000 to €1.2m
item.description: Bonhams shows two F.P. Journe watches in Geneva on 5 and 6 November ahead of its Paris Fine Watches sale on 19 November. The second watch, a Chronomètre à Résonance, is estimated at €300,000 to €600,000.

item.title: Brilliant Earth Q3 orders rise 5.6%, average order value falls 3.1%
item.description: Orders were 52,720 against 49,910, while average order value fell to $2,140 from $2,209 in the quarter to 30 September. Net sales were $112.8m, and the company forecasts full-year 2026 growth of 2.75% to 4% on 2025's $437m.

item.title: Royal Gold's Q3 revenue rises 84% to $464.8m, debt cleared in October
item.description: Operating cash flow reached a record $344.4m on 109,000 gold-equivalent ounces sold, against 72,900 a year earlier. The last $150m on its credit facility was repaid on 19 October.

item.title: China's nine-month jewellery gold falls 33.86% on year, bars up 26.26%
item.description: The China Gold Association put January-to-September consumption at 684.623 tonnes, up 0.28% on the year, in figures carried by Xinhua. Jewellery took 178.612 tonnes and bars and coins 444.576 tonnes.

item.title: Pandora reports 6% Q3 organic growth and narrows 2026 guidance
item.description: Third-quarter revenue was DKK 6,694 million against 6,269 million a year earlier, with like-for-like growth of 4%. Guidance is now 2-3% organic growth, previously 0-3%, and an EBIT margin of 22.5-23%, previously 22-23%.

item.title: Gem Diamonds' Letšeng averages $1,945 a carat in Q3, up 73% on year
item.description: Gem Diamonds sold 17,899 carats from Letšeng in the third quarter for $34.8m, against 22,830 carats and $25.7m a year earlier. Four stones above $1m each brought in $22.2m, and the miner raised its 2026 guidance.

item.title: Petra Diamonds signs advance-payment deal worth at least $20m
item.description: An unnamed mid-stream diamantaire group will advance cash against all future Cullinan run-of-mine output. Petra's quarterly revenue fell to $21m at $63 a carat, and net debt rose to $348m.

item.title: Monaco Legend reports €22.26m and 100% sell-through at its watch sale
item.description: The sell-through rate is the house's own figure, and it gives no lot count. A Rolex 6062 led at €1,858,000 with premium; the house's April sale made €26.47m across 288 lots.

item.title: Central banks buy 321.2t of gold in Q3; jewellery down 17% on year
item.description: Total demand, including OTC, slipped 1% on the year to 1,368.6 tonnes, the World Gold Council says. ETFs added 211.2 tonnes, bar and coin fell 19% on the year, and jewellery had its weakest third quarter in the series.

item.title: FCA suspends Petra Diamonds' listing with its audit unfinished
item.description: London trading in the shares stopped at 07:30 UK time on 2 November, after Petra missed the 31 October deadline for its annual report. Petra says restoration will not be automatic once it publishes.

item.title: Phillips estimates Cartier Portico clock No. 4 at CHF 1.8m to 3.6m
item.description: The 1924 mystery clock, one of six in the series, is Lot 220 at the Geneva Watch Auction XXIV on 7 and 8 November. Its sister, No. 3, sold for CHF 3,932,000 at Phillips in May 2025.

item.title: Lao Feng Xiang ends September with 4,809 outlets, down 107 in Q3
item.description: According to a summary of the company's notice, the chain closed 194 outlets and opened 87 in the third quarter. Main-business revenue fell 44.67% over nine months, and gross margin rose to 10.43%.

item.title: SNB books CHF 1.2bn gold gain after a CHF 6.4bn loss in H1
item.description: The Swiss National Bank's nine-month profit was CHF 44.2bn, with CHF 43.3bn on foreign currency positions. Gold traded at CHF 112,118 a kilogram at end-September, against CHF 104,812 at end-June.

item.title: Cartier 11.5-ct sapphire ring makes €205,400 at Bonhams Paris
item.description: Bonhams says the Madagascan stone shows no indications of treatment; the ring made 3.4 times its high estimate on 29 October. A Cartier rose brooch made €83,800 against €15,000 to €20,000.

item.title: 8.63-carat pink leads Sotheby's Geneva with CHF 3.3m-5m estimate
item.description: JCK reports the unmounted fancy intense pink heads Sotheby's High Jewelry sale at the Mandarin Oriental on 11 November. A Graff ring with a 2.88-carat fancy deep blue carries an estimate of CHF 1.7 million to 2.5 million.

item.title: Agnico Eagle output falls 6.1% in Q3 as realised gold rises 22.7%
item.description: The miner expects 2026 payable output at the low end of its 3.3 million to 3.5 million ounce range. Canadian Malartic made 111,202 ounces in the third quarter, 29.1% below a year earlier, as lower-grade stockpiles supplemented mill feed.

item.title: Shanghai Gold Exchange volume up 7.6% on year to 5,064.6 tonnes
item.description: In its September market report, China's central bank puts Shanghai Futures Exchange gold volume down 12.8% on the year. It does not say whether the exchange tonnage counts one side of each trade or both.

item.title: Chrono24 watch price index closes Q3 at 1,471, up 0.7%
item.description: Haute Time, citing Chrono24's Q3 Quarterly Dial, puts the index 7.5% above a year earlier. Vacheron Constantin led with 17.7% over twelve months, Patek Philippe 17.0%, while Rolex slipped 0.2% in the quarter.

item.title: Il Ponte's jewellery sale totals over €3 million, 98% of lots sold
item.description: The Milan house's off-calendar Important Jewellery auction ran on 7 and 8 October. A Nardi coral necklace and a Cartier pearl-and-diamond choker each sold for €88,200, among the highlights it names.

item.title: Lab-grown producers' council threatens action over 'synthetic'
item.description: The Diamond Producers Council told jewelers on 20 October to reject CIBJO's September call for the word. It says its members grow more than 20 million carats a year.

item.title: IGI's lab-grown jewelry segment grows 47%, natural jewelry 3%
item.description: Revenue at the Mumbai-listed grader rose 31% to INR 3,980 million in the July to September quarter. Profit after tax rose 43% to INR 1,858 million on 4.35 million reports.

item.title: Audemars Piguet charges sellers up to 20% on its own resale site
item.description: The Watch Keepers, run by AP itself, listed 43 watches on 26 October. Buying and selling are open only to verified residents of the European Union and Switzerland.
